F-01.mechanism: rollback now validates every owned path from the receipt and from the in-target ownership record: canonical relative POSIX path, inside the owned install prefix, no .., no absolute/drive/backslash, no Windows trailing dot/space or reserved device name, no Windows-normalized collision, no symlink escape; rejection happens before any deletion
F-01.title: rollback used receipt owned.files[].install_path to delete outside the target

F-02.mechanism: rollback performs no recursive deletion driven by any receipt path; it only confirms the terminal state of the staging directory bound by the ownership record; a residual staging directory is a stable ROLLBACK_CONFLICT with diagnostics retained and nothing is deleted
F-02.title: rollback rmtree'd the arbitrary directory named by receipt staging.path

M-01.mechanism: rollback binds the normalized target identity (path + sha256), the sandbox parent identity, the sandbox marker identity, the non-colliding session and the source candidate/manifest/payload set through the in-target ownership record, and cross-checks the external receipt against it; basename is never used to decide ownership
M-01.title: rollback bound the target only by basename (cross-sandbox deletion)

m-01.mechanism: uniqueness uses a Windows normalization key (per-component trailing dot and space stripped, lower-cased) instead of lower() alone; trailing dot/space segments and reserved device names are rejected outright
m-01.title: Windows trailing dot/space normalization collision was not rejected

m-02.mechanism: the original runner is kept unchanged as history; the new correction-01 runner uses try/finally plus its own TemporaryDirectory and records the measured cleanup result for every path, including failures
m-02.title: the original chain runner leaked its own temp root on failure paths

m-03.mechanism: external manifest read/parse/type failures are now a stable BAD_INPUT
m-03.title: an unreadable/invalid external --manifest produced INTERNAL_ERROR

known_leftovers_not_deleted.reason: provably created by this implementer, but it is the exact residue cited by the independent review finding m-02; the correction contract forbids deleting review failure evidence

limitations: the ownership record is a local persistent record; it defends against external receipt replacement/rebinding, not against an actor with write access to the target who also recomputes install_hash (the correction contract explicitly does not require that)

ownership is decided by normalized target identity + sandbox marker identity + non-colliding session + source candidate/manifest/payload set + install hash + per-file hash re-verification; never by basename alone and never by an equal file hash alone
all verification ran on a POSIX (WSL2) sandbox: no real Windows host, no ComfyUI, no Ollama, no GPU, no model, no media, no network, no download
the two tool files and the whole preparation-04 tree are not listed in MANIFEST.sha256, so verify_pack does not hash-cover them; their integrity is bound here by SHA-256 and by the Git blobs
